suppress.notes: False positive: this package is the PostgreSQL JDBC client driver, not the PostgreSQL server binary. Dependency-Check attaches the PostgreSQL server CPE because the artifact name is also "postgresql".

False positive: run.ratchet artifacts are first-party project modules, not NVD-indexed third-party products. Dependency-Check can attach CPEs based on artifact names such as ratchet-store-postgresql; third-party dependencies inside those artifacts remain separately visible.
False positive: CVE-2026-0994 is published for the Python pip protobuf package and google.protobuf.json_format.ParseDict(). This project only receives the Java runtime jar through mysql-connector-j.
